title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Sofia Patel
description: This PR adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and corresponding docs site updates aimed at making it easier for developers to onboard and prototype RAG-enabled agents with Redwood. Motivation: we keep seeing teams reimplementing similar scaffolding for agents + tool calling; providing curated templates and opinionated quickstarts should reduce time-to-first-success and create consistent examples we can test and iterate on. Scope: 1) new example templates under redwood-examples/agents/rag with preconfigured retrieval + simple tool adapters (search, ticket-create, calendar). 2) quickstart guides for the docs site (docs/quickstarts/rag-agent.md) including step-by-step setup, code snippets for Python/TS SDKs, and deployment notes for Hosted/Dedicated/Private. 3) a small demo app and sample dataset for local testing. Checklist: - [x] Add agent templates and sample config - [x] Add Python + TypeScript quickstarts and copy snippets to docs site - [x] Add CI integration test to smoke-run examples in GH Actions - [x] Docs site navigation entry and redirects for older RAG pages - [x] Address feedback from docs and examples reviewers Related: ENG-8421 (workstream for agent templates), PM-512 (product pitch). Notable design choices: - Provide a lightweight retrieval adapter by default (file-based vector store) and clearly document how to swap to Redis/vector DB or cloud index. - Tool adapter interfaces were kept minimal (sync HTTP call and async background tasks) to reduce surface area for quickstarts; examples include more advanced adapters in separate files. How to validate locally: follow docs/quickstarts/rag-agent.md to run containerized example (./scripts/run-demo.sh), or run the smoke tests in .github/workflows/examples-smoke.yml. Deployment notes: mention that Dedicated customers should pin model versions in their rollout config and Disabled KV cache must be documented for certain private deployments (see section in docs). Migration/compatibility: added redirects from previous docs pages and deprecated the old rag-playbooks examples with a link to the new templates. Security: sample config uses environment variables for API keys and includes a short note about using KMS for Private deployments. Testing: added a lightweight integration GH Action that launches the demo container and runs the agent against the sample dataset (smoke only).
